topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture scope, learning outcomes, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulation of Proliferative and Growth-Inhibitory Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream intracellular cascades drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how malignancies in both hematopoietic and epithelial tissues arrest cellular differentiation to maintain a proliferative state.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in the p53 tumor suppressor pathway and BCL2 family proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere maintenance and evasion of p53-mediated stress senescence grant cancer cells unlimited replicative potential.

topics.label: Altered Energy Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the shift to aerobic glycolysis and the epigenetic consequences of metabolic enzyme mutations in cancer.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the requirement, timing, and molecular balance governing new blood vessel recruitment in growing tumors.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step metastatic cascade, clinical detection of circulating tumor cells, and genomic features of distant dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by contextualizing modern hallmark literature and directing students to upcoming practicals.
